name: Jos Mental Health Conference
tagline: Transforming Lives, One Mind at a Time.
description: The Jos Mental Health Conference (JMHC) is a multidisciplinary platform for mental health in Jos, Plateau State and Northern Nigeria. Next edition: 2027.
vision: A society where mental health is prioritised, mental health services are accessible, and individuals and communities can achieve psychological well-being and resilience.
mission: To unite mental health stakeholders through knowledge exchange, professional capacity building, public engagement, strategic partnerships, and advocacy that strengthen mental health and psychosocial support systems in Jos and beyond.
purpose: The Jos Mental Health Conference exists to create a sustained platform for collaboration among organisations and individuals working to improve mental health. It seeks to move conversations beyond awareness towards shared learning, coordinated action, and lasting improvements in services and community well-being.
emergency: This website is not a crisis service. If you or someone near you is in immediate danger, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency unit.
